doc.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: A month at the Five Spot with Monk, left out of the biography
summary: He played a month with Monk and tries to recall the drummer, perhaps Ben Riley.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: I was left out of Monk’s biography. I played a gig with him at the Five Spot for a month, and it was left out of the biography.
Do you recall who was in Monk’s band at the time?
Frankie Dunlap? He played with you, too.
Well, Monk didn’t use that many different drummers...
Well, this was a guy who worked with me later on in Long Island. He worked with me at the Vanguard.
Because he played with Monk and recorded with you, too.
Ben Riley played with Monk for years, but that began in 1964...
Ben Riley might have been who it was.
